Cached prompt is now available
You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts.
sources.supports: xAI announced cached prompts on May 29, 2025, before models.dev's June 10 start for this price record.
xAI's current model metadata assigns Grok 3 a cached prompt rate alongside its input and completion rates; the rate corresponds to $0.75 per million cached input tokens.

notes: The June 17 models.dev commit describes a schema rename and removal of zero-valued cache fields, rather than a provider price change. xAI had already announced cached prompts by May 29; its current Grok 3 metadata shows a nonzero cached prompt rate, consistent with a catalog omission. Internet Archive CDX did not respond during this research, so no historical snapshot bracket or exact provider effective date could be established.
